# Autom

Autom is a service that delivers lightning-fast search engine results page (SERP) outcomes for Google, Bing, and Brave, offering developers rapid access to search data with minimal latency.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/autom/.

## Actions

- **Google Countries** (read-only): List google-supported countries.
- **Google Images** (read-only): Fetch images from google search results.
- **Google Languages** (read-only): Retrieve google-supported languages.
- **Google Locations** (read-only): Retrieve google-supported locations.
